correctness.rationale: The local calculation is correct. After \(\Phi_n(X)=\Phi_{\operatorname{rad}(n)}(X^{n/\operatorname{rad}(n)})\), cancelling all Möbius factors supported on the recovered prefix leaves a product whose unique smallest remaining exponent is the next prime. Its coefficient is an \(\ell\)-adic unit, while every other term has strictly larger valuation, so \(\nu_\ell(R_j-1)=a\,\nu_\ell(x)\,p_{j+1}\). The sign congruences for odd \(\ell\) and for \(\ell=2\) at depth at least two also follow from the first nonconstant term. The archived finite check is consistent but is not used as proof.
